description: This file defines a Spring configuration class 'WorkerConfig' that conditionally enables batch worker components within the fineract project, including bean definitions for an inbound request channel and an input channel interceptor.

classes.name: WorkerConfig
classes.description: Spring configuration class that activates batch worker components if the 'fineract.mode.batch-worker-enabled' property is set to true.

methods.name: inboundRequests
methods.description: Defines a Spring bean for an inbound request channel using QueueChannel.

methods.name: inputInterceptor
methods.description: Defines a Spring bean for an InputChannelInterceptor instance to handle input channel interception.
